driftAndDuplicates.detail: Legacy Suisse/FK/Noto family and newer Source Sans/Source Serif/Mada/Amiri/Handjet roles coexist. Current public pages should consistently layer typography.css last; optional IBM Plex Arabic/Rakkas remain library specimens.
Byte-identical duplicate static files. Older integration fonts also duplicate direction-review inputs.
SHA-256 shows repeated board PNGs across current/export/archive folders. Preserve these as snapshots; use documented current unified exports for review.
Exact duplicate images have different catalogue IDs: G3-001/G2-017, G3-002/G2-005, G3-014/G2-014, G3-015/G2-022, G3-021/G2-002.
Current and previous-public copies hash identically at inventory time; keep the previous-public location historical rather than an alternate import path.

maturityDefinitions.verified: Recorded, scoped validation exists; not automatically product/release ready.
maturityDefinitions.prototype: Runnable specimen or authored design with known integration/QA boundaries.
maturityDefinitions.reference: Evidence, source, candidate, or static export that informs design; not a supported consumer API.
maturityDefinitions.legacy: Superseded or archived material retained for context and provenance.
